product_overview: Masjid At-Taqwa Digital Ecosystem is a comprehensive, culturally-sensitive web platform tailored to serve Islamic communities by integrating worship, education, community engagement, and administrative management into a unified digital experience.
core_goals: Provide accurate and locally relevant Islamic prayer times with Qibla direction and Hijri calendar integration
Deliver age-appropriate Islamic educational content with interactive learning and progress tracking
Enable effective community engagement via announcements, events, and discussion tools
Maintain secure, role-based user authentication honoring Islamic privacy principles
Optimize user experience with Islamic design values and fully responsive interfaces
Support administrators with robust content and user management tools
Ensure high availability, security, and scalability with modern technology stack and infrastructure
key_features: Dynamic Islamic Hero Slider featuring Arabic calligraphy and community messages
Prayer Times Widget with live status and Qibla compass
Comprehensive Islamic Community Dashboard with personalized learning plans
Age-tier Islamic Education System with quizzes and memorization tracking
Robust Islamic Services API with multi-layer prayer time fallbacks and admin control
Announcement Management with rich media support and moderation workflow
Event Management system integrating Islamic calendar and RSVP functionalities
JWT-based Authentication and Role-Based Access Control
Custom Islamic Design System with color palette, Arabic typography, and geometric patterns
Mobile-first Responsive Design optimized for performance and accessibility
Hijri Calendar Integration with seasonal and event synchronization
Monitoring & Analytics dashboard for system health and user engagement
SEO & Structured Data optimized for Arabic and Islamic content
Reusable UI Component Library adhering to Islamic visual standards
user_flow_summary: Users register and authenticate with role assignment and age-tier preferences
Users access prayer times, view Qibla direction, and consult Islamic calendar
Students browse filtered educational content, take quizzes, and track progress
Community members view and interact with announcements and upcoming events
Administrators create and moderate announcements, events, and educational content
Users receive personalized content recommendations and notifications
System monitors performance and security with real-time alerts
validation_criteria: Successful JWT authentication and role enforcement with secure session handling
Prayer times calculated accurately with fallback APIs and location awareness
Educational content correctly filtered by age tier and subject with progress tracking
Announcements and events support rich media, categorization, and admin moderation
Responsive UI rendering correctly across devices with Arabic/English support and RTL handling
Performance meets response time thresholds under concurrent user load
Security controls including input validation, encryption, and auditing function as specified
Automated backups and system failover respond within recovery time limits
User feedback surveys meet target satisfaction ratings for UI and content quality
